newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Banco Liniers says Bankers Trust to buy 51% stake.
newsitem.headline: Banco Liniers says Bankers Trust to buy 51% stake.

text.p: Argentina's Banco Liniers Sudamericano SA (BLS) announced Monday that New York-based BLTA Holdings LLC, controlled by Bankers Trust Co, has signed a deal to buy a 51 percent stake in it.

"The acquisition will be done in the form of a capital increase and is in the process of being approved by Argentina's Central Bank," Banco Liniers said in a letter to to the Buenos Aires Stock Exchange.
Banco Liniers, based in Buenos Aires, focuses its strategy in developing consumer credit lines, its main business being credit cards and car loans.
It issues Mastercard, Argencard and Visa credit cards.
Alejandro Laurence and Luis Posse will remain in charge of the management and strategic development of the bank as president and vice president, respectively, BLS said.
No other details about the deal were immediately available.
